# dsh-flash-proxy
> **简体中文说明文档**

System proxy control for DeepSeek Harness — NO_PROXY policy management,
connection diagnostics, and
proxy environment inventory.
## Features
- **System Proxy Toggle** — Global on/off master switch (like System Alerts); turns the entire proxy

feature on or off
- **Proxy Mode Selector** — Choose between All Proxy, API Bypass, All Bypass, or

Custom NO_PROXY (nested under the master switch)
- **Use System Proxy** — On Windows and macOS, read
the system proxy (Windows WinINet `Internet Settings` registry, or macOS active network service via

`scutil`) and optionally use it for this process instead of the launch-environment proxy
- **Connec

tion Test** — Diagnose outbound connectivity with redirect chain analysis
- **Proxy Environment** —
Read-only inventory of HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY / ALL_PROXY / NO_PROXY, plus the system-proxy snapsh

ot
- **Diagnostics Log** — Detailed test results with timing and error codes
## Installation
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Requires the core `dsh-flash` `>=1.0.0-0 <2.0.0-0` for the QuickControl registry; the dock-base work
bench UI comes from the `dock-flash` v3 adapter.
## Repository Mirrors

Development happens on Gitee; GitHub is a read-only mirror kept in sync by
`.github/workflows/sync-f

rom-gitee.yml`
(every 6 hours, or on demand from the Actions tab).
| Host | Role | URL |

| Gitee | source of truth | https://gitee.com/lenin.guo/dsh-flash-proxy |
| GitHub | mirror | https:
//github.com/tcgbp/dsh-flash-proxy |

Open issues and pull requests on Gitee — a merge made on GitHub is overwritten by
the next sync.
## Settings
| Field | Default | Description |
| `proxyEnabled` | `true` | Global master switch — when `false`, all requests go direct regardless o

f `proxyMode` |
| `proxyMode` | `all-proxy` | NO_PROXY policy: `all-proxy` / `api-bypass` / `all-byp

ass` / `custom` |
| `customNoProxy` | `''` | Custom NO_PROXY value (only when `proxyMode` is `custom

`) |
| `testUrl` | `https://www.google.com/generate_204` | URL the connection test probes |
| `useSy
stemProxy` | `false` | Windows/macOS: use the OS system proxy instead of the launch environment (ign
ored on other platforms) |
## System Proxy (Windows WinINet registry / macOS scutil)

On Windows, `dsh-flash-proxy` reads the system proxy stored in the
`HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\

CurrentVersion\Internet Settings` registry keys.
On macOS it reads the current network service's pro

xy settings via
`scutil --proxy` (JSON form when available, with a legacy text fallback). The
QuickC

ontrol panel shows a read-only snapshot (`proxyEnable`, `proxyServer`,
`proxyOverride`, `autoConfigU

rl`, `autoDetect`) and derives the equivalent proxy
environment from it for display.

- A plain `host:port` proxy is mapped to both `HTTP_PROXY` and `HTTPS_PROXY`
(surfaced as `ALL_PROXY

`).
- A segmented value (`http=…;https=…;ftp=…`; the macOS reader produces
`http=…;https=…` from the

per-protocol HTTP(S) proxy) is parsed per protocol.
- The bypass list (`ProxyOverride` on Windows,

`ExceptionsList` on macOS) is
translated into `NO_PROXY`; the `<local>` token is dropped (the plugin

grammar
does not accept it).

When the **Use System Proxy** toggle is ON, the host is Windows or macOS, and the
master switch is e

nabled, the effective `HTTP_PROXY` / `HTTPS_PROXY` /
`ALL_PROXY` and `NO_PROXY` are taken from the s

ystem-proxy snapshot instead of
the launch environment. All other platforms ignore this toggle and k

eep the
default (localStorage) behaviour unchanged.
## Migration from dock-flash

If you previously used dock-flash's built-in proxy controls, `dsh-flash-proxy` will
automatically mi
grate your settings on first launch.
